ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white regions to low-intensity black/grey regions, with white dominant on central lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes. High-contrast dark mottling and solid bands concentrated at the median notch and along the trailing edges. Distinct dark circular focal spots at approximately 20% and 10% of the left lobe horizontal axis, and 85% of the right lobe horizontal axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude (jaggedness) at the terminal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel anomalies located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, thin dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white surfaces, particularly visible on the lower-left quadrant and upper-right quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks across the ventral surface and dense scarring/irregularities on the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct, isolated dark circular spots positioned within the white pigmented fields of the lobes, functioning as high-contrast focal points.
